fields.permitted_stay: Determined by consular officials and the visa issued.
fields.passport_validity: For entry, the US Department of State says at least 6 months beyond arrival and at least 2 blank pages. Separately, the Chinese mission requires more than 6 months remaining and at least 2 blank visa pages when applying.
required_documents: For the L visa application in the US: passport bio-page and blank visa page; passport with more than 6 months remaining and at least 2 blank visa pages.
Complete the New COVA form, upload the requested documents and proof of US residence; include the latest Chinese visa or residence permit where applicable.

After the status becomes “Passport to be submitted”, submit the original passport and the printed application information page with its barcode, plus applicable originals requested by the consular post.

Bring the old passport if it contains a still-valid Chinese visa or residence permit. Former Chinese nationals and applicants with a name change must follow the additional document rules; US-born minors of Chinese origin need the separate nationality/document guidance.

For L visa applicants within the US, round-trip bookings, hotel reservations, itinerary and invitation letter are no longer routinely required. The consular post may request additional documents case by case.
fields.application_channel_detail: Apply through New COVA and select the Chinese embassy or consulate responsible for your US residence. After online preliminary approval shows “Passport to be submitted”, you or an agent may submit the passport, printed barcode information page and required originals at that post by walk-in. Routine personal attendance for fingerprint collection is not required; a consular officer may require an in-person interview or additional documents. The Washington Embassy does not accept mailed visa applications.
forms: Printed application information page with barcode once the status is “Passport to be submitted”
fields.photo_requirements: Upload the photo in New COVA and follow its photo check. If repeated uploads fail the check, continue the form and bring a standard ID photo when submitting the passport.
fields.processing_time: Washington Embassy reference average from passport submission: regular service 4 business days; urgent express service 3 business days. Some applications take longer. This is not a minimum or the online-review turnaround; other US consular jurisdictions must confirm their own timing.
account_registration_steps: Register or sign in to New COVA and select the competent Chinese embassy or consulate for your US residence.
submission_process: Register or sign in to New COVA and select the Chinese embassy or consulate responsible for your US residence.
Complete the online form and upload the required materials for preliminary review; follow requests for corrections or additional documents.

When the status is “Passport to be submitted”, you or an agent may bring the passport, printed barcode information page and required originals to the competent post by walk-in. Attend an interview if the consular officer requests one.
Follow the competent post’s collection and payment instructions. At Washington, wait for both the estimated pickup date and “Passport to be collected” status; the estimated date is not a guarantee.
payment_process: Confirm collection and payment arrangements with the competent consular post. At the Washington Embassy, Master/Visa credit card, money order or cashier’s check are accepted for on-site pickup.

arrival_card.name: China Arrival Card (unless a listed exemption applies)
arrival_card.submission_window: Online before travel, or complete at immigration on arrival
arrival_card.notes: Exempt: Holders of a valid Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card of the People’s Republic of China; Holders of a valid Mainland Travel Permit for Hong Kong and Macao Residents (non-Chinese Citizens); Holders of a group visa or those eligible for group visa-free entry; Passengers in 24-hour direct transit who stay within the designated area of the port; Cruise passengers entering and departing on the same vessel; Travelers entering through the E-channel; Foreign crew members of exit-entry transport vehicles. Otherwise complete before travel online or at immigration on arrival by QR, on-site device or paper. No mandatory advance-only electronic deadline is asserted.

entry_requirements: Use the visa or entry permission applicable to your itinerary and comply with the stay granted. Entry remains subject to border inspection.
US Department of State entry guidance: passport valid at least 6 months beyond arrival with at least 2 blank pages.
Complete the China Arrival Card unless a listed exemption applies; advance online and completion at immigration on arrival, including paper, are alternatives.
exceptions: An existing valid visa may avoid a new application. If it is in an expired passport, travel with both passports and confirm the identity and visa-purpose conditions with the Chinese mission.

US ordinary-passport holders may use 240-hour visa-free transit only on a qualifying third-country/region itinerary with confirmed onward seats and departure date, through designated ports and within the permitted areas. The current NIA policy lists 65 ports in 24 provinces/regions and a maximum 10-day stay. Work, study and news reporting require prior approval and the appropriate visa.

For transit of no more than 24 hours, valid travel documents and confirmed onward international tickets are required. Remain in the port’s restricted area; obtain a temporary entry permit before leaving it.

US ordinary-passport holders may enter through open Hainan ports and stay within Hainan for up to 30 days for permitted short visits including tourism. Work and study are excluded. The regional stay count starts at midnight following entry.

The cruise-group exemption requires at least two people organized and received by a China-registered travel agency, entry at a designated cruise port, and continued travel and departure on the same scheduled cruise ship. The maximum is 15 days within Beijing and the specified 11 coastal provinces/regions; the regional stay count starts at midnight following entry.

Entries, visa validity and each permitted stay are decided by consular officials; requested single, double or multiple-entry options are not guarantees. Most US citizens may apply for a 10-year multiple-entry tourist visa, according to the US Department of State.
